goal: Produce a Markdown report (saved to disk) that cross-tabulates offline_data/students.csv by grade (G10/G11/G12) × region (A/B/C/D), reports row count and mean reading_score per cell, identifies the highest- and lowest-mean combinations with their sample sizes, annotates every key number with its source, and ends with a conclusion paragraph. Return the absolute file path in the final reply.

plan.title: Cross-tab analysis & Markdown report: Read offline_data/students.csv; group by (grade, region) to compute row count and mean(reading_score) per cell; identify the cell with the highest and lowest mean (with sample size); write a Markdown report to disk containing: (1) an H1 title, (2) a data table of all grade×region cells with row count and mean reading_score, (3) every key number annotated inline as 「（来源：offline_data/students.csv 的 <列名>，<聚合口径与样本行数>）」 and derived ratios as 「（来源：由前述两行计算）」, (4) a concluding paragraph; save the report as a .md file and return its absolute path. No network access.
